threads.body: [Testing] In the default legacy-semconv task, `assertMetrics()` only verifies that stable metrics are absent, so this test never proves that the second invocation of the reused event starts event and message processing. A regression that suppresses the second event would still pass that task. Assert the second trace's three spans so the reuse behavior is covered in every mode.

threads.body: [Testing] The new javaagent selection branch is not exercised by the added library tests: those use the library-loaded `ContextKey`, while this advice intentionally has an independently loaded selection. The existing javaagent test only covers a single non-nested event, so using `functionContext` instead of `ambientContext` here (or otherwise breaking same-event delegation/distinct-event nesting) would go undetected. Add javaagent tests that invoke a nested `RequestHandler` with both the same `SQSEvent` and a distinct event, and assert the resulting processing-span counts.
